content.json:
# Netskope Client Status
Monitor client deployment, operating systems, connectivity, health, and the latest device events. Numeric API codes are retained in the table and the adjacent `*_name` columns are used throughout this workbook.

content.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend DeviceKey = case(isnotempty(device_hash), device_hash, isnotempty(guid), guid, isnotempty(device_id), device_id, host_info_hostname)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceKey
| summarize Devices = count()
content.title: Reporting devices

content.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend DeviceKey = case(isnotempty(device_hash), device_hash, isnotempty(guid), guid, isnotempty(device_id), device_id, host_info_hostname)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceKey
| where last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name == "ENABLED"
| summarize Enabled = count()
content.title: Enabled clients

content.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend DeviceKey = case(isnotempty(device_hash), device_hash, isnotempty(guid), guid, isnotempty(device_id), device_id, host_info_hostname)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceKey
| where last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name in ("DISABLED", "UNINSTALLED", "DORMANT") or last_seen_device_event_status_name in ("DISABLED", "UNINSTALLED", "ERRORED", "BACKED_OFF", "DORMANT") or last_seen_device_event_npa_status_name in ("UNABLE_TO_ENROLL", "ERRORED") or last_seen_device_event_event_name in ("DISCONNECTED_ERROR", "DISCONNECTED_ERROR_MODERN_STANDBY", "DISCONNECTED_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN_ERROR", "UNINSTALLED", "INSTALLATION_FAILURE", "USER_DISABLED_BY_OTP", "UNINSTALLATION_FAILURE", "UPGRADE_FAILURE", "ROLLBACK_FAILURE", "CA_INSTALLATION_FAILURE")
| summarize NeedsAttention = count()
content.title: Clients needing attention

content.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend DeviceKey = case(isnotempty(device_hash), device_hash, isnotempty(guid), guid, isnotempty(device_id), device_id, host_info_hostname)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceKey
| where user_info_device_classification_status_name == "MANAGED"
| summarize Managed = count()
content.title: Managed devices

content.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend DeviceKey = case(isnotempty(device_hash), device_hash, isnotempty(guid), guid, isnotempty(device_id), device_id, host_info_hostname)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceKey
| extend ClientState = iff(isempty(last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name), "UNKNOWN", last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name)
| summarize Devices = count() by ClientState
| order by Devices desc
content.title: Client Status V2 distribution

content.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend DeviceKey = case(isnotempty(device_hash), device_hash, isnotempty(guid), guid, isnotempty(device_id), device_id, host_info_hostname)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceKey
| extend NpaState = iff(isempty(last_seen_device_event_npa_status_name), "UNKNOWN", last_seen_device_event_npa_status_name)
| summarize Devices = count() by NpaState
| order by Devices desc
content.title: NPA status distribution

content.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend DeviceKey = case(isnotempty(device_hash), device_hash, isnotempty(guid), guid, isnotempty(device_id), device_id, host_info_hostname)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceKey
| extend OperatingSystem = iff(isempty(host_info_os_name), "UNKNOWN", host_info_os_name)
| summarize Devices = count() by OperatingSystem
| order by Devices desc
content.title: Operating system distribution

content.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend ClientEvent = iff(isempty(last_seen_device_event_event_name), "UNKNOWN_EVENT", last_seen_device_event_event_name)
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), ClientEvent
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Client events over time

content.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend DeviceKey = case(isnotempty(device_hash), device_hash, isnotempty(guid), guid, isnotempty(device_id), device_id, host_info_hostname)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceKey
| where last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name in ("DISABLED", "UNINSTALLED", "DORMANT") or last_seen_device_event_status_name in ("DISABLED", "UNINSTALLED", "ERRORED", "BACKED_OFF", "DORMANT") or last_seen_device_event_npa_status_name in ("UNABLE_TO_ENROLL", "ERRORED") or last_seen_device_event_event_name in ("DISCONNECTED_ERROR", "DISCONNECTED_ERROR_MODERN_STANDBY", "DISCONNECTED_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN_ERROR", "UNINSTALLED", "INSTALLATION_FAILURE", "USER_DISABLED_BY_OTP", "UNINSTALLATION_FAILURE", "UPGRADE_FAILURE", "ROLLBACK_FAILURE", "CA_INSTALLATION_FAILURE")
| project LastReported = TimeGenerated, Hostname = host_info_hostname, Username = user_info_username, OS = host_info_os_name, DeviceClassification = user_info_device_classification_status_name, ClientStatusV2 = last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name, LegacyStatus = last_seen_device_event_status_name, NpaStatus = last_seen_device_event_npa_status_name, LastEvent = last_seen_device_event_event_name, Actor = last_seen_device_event_actor_name, ClientVersion = client_version, PublicIp = last_connected_from_public_ip, DeviceKey
| order by LastReported desc
content.title: Devices requiring attention

content.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project TimeGenerated, Hostname = host_info_hostname, Username = user_info_username, EventCode = last_seen_device_event_event, EventName = last_seen_device_event_event_name, ActorCode = last_seen_device_event_actor, ActorName = last_seen_device_event_actor_name, ClientStatusV2Code = last_seen_device_event_status_v2, ClientStatusV2Name = last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name, NpaStatusCode = last_seen_device_event_npa_status, NpaStatusName = last_seen_device_event_npa_status_name, ServiceName = last_seen_device_event_service_name, EventDetails = last_seen_device_event_event_details
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.title: Recent client events with code mappings
